★ Request
Show Kiseki (Summer Jersey)
Yes!!! That's actually true!!

Though, you're right! The scene where Joanna and the others hold
a cosplay contest in the department store was super popular with everyone!

...Please don't leave me behind...! I'm begging you...!
Take me with you...!
—That is precisely why.

Huh? Other scenes too, you say?
No, what I used as reference was... the cosplay—
Gave me an irreplaceable experience.

Ahaha! Well then, what should we wear next?
Maybe a fantasy look, like a wizard? Wanna give it a shot!?

Ah, sorry for shouting...! Um, well...
I mean, I'm pretty confident in it, but... wh-what did you think?

Thank goodness... Come on, let's get moving!
Otherwise, those things will—

Is that so? Then from now on,
you should totally just wear that to work!

Hearing Kiseki share that brings a smile to my face.
All we did was spend time together, but it seems to have fueled her creative spirit.

I mean, it's my first time trying it, but... cosplay is so much fun!
Oh, I know! Why don't you join in? I'll pick out an outfit for you!

Or rather... hehe.
Did you notice anything?

...... There was a clothing store back that way.
Considering the emergency, I'll go grab us a change of clothes!

...Those moments were like gems to me.
A final 25 minutes where I forgot everything—and shared a laugh with her.

One day during summer training camp. Operating my tablet, I close the manuscript
Kiseki shared with me. As for my impressions of this work titled 'I'm the Last One'—
E-Excuse me!

...Wait, really? Now that you mention it, that's true. The part where the two of them
tour the art exhibition was taken straight from my time with you, Trainer...

...Those moments were like gems to me.
A final 25 minutes where I forgot everything—and shared a laugh with him.

————!!! Get up!!
Hurry!!

...Ahaha, oh man.
My face is burning up.

...... Ahaha.
You really are something, Trainer—
Because I poured every moment I felt was 'fun' right into my work.
I won't let those bastards pick what I wear when I die.

...Every single panel was practically overflowing with it...
That feeling of, 'Hanging out with Trainer was so much fun.'
Aagh... UAAAGHHH, AAAAGHH!!
That's why... hehe.

When I was storyboarding, I thought, 'This is it!!'
Once I drew it, it ended up becoming one of my favorite scenes too!

...*huff*, *pant*, *gasp*...
Are you alright? Can you still run?

In under a single month, humanity was overwhelmed by the living dead that devour all life—
the ZBSS... Stripping away our peaceful everyday lives.

I explain that precisely because the story had been so tense up to that point,
the lighthearted banter between the characters brought a genuine smile to my face.
I really can't beat you.

This looks like a suit worn by a character I love.
That's why I picked it.

You said it! No taking it back, okay?
If you're game, Trainer, I'm totally dragging you along again!?

Taking photos with mascots, viewing raw manuscript pages... Now that she mentioned it,
I realized those scenes mirrored 'what happened that day'—

Well, that's, um... I showed it to you earlier today, right Trainer?
It's because you let me draw that manga...

...Of course it turned out interesting!
Because—

Waaah! I'm so glad!
! ...Oh man, I can't stop grinning!
Hehe... A smile that looks like it belongs on a two-page spread.

...I'll end it all. For the sake of the next generation.
Just watch me. That's how I'm going to survive—

Oh yeeeeeah!! We did it!!
!

...Um, well, just for a moment!!
Could you give me some time to think it over!?

Y-You promised, didn't you?! That we'd go to the art exhibition again!
That we'd take photos with Ushippy and the others... You promised...!

It was a thrilling triumph that delivered everything a classic panic horror should.
I was completely captivated by the visceral zombie depictions and the characters' charm, but above all—

Prompted by her words, something that caught my attention comes to mind.
Could it be that the cosplay contest scene was—

It's a token of my thanks. Inside are manga I recommend... I intentionally picked
a variety of genres, so I'm sure you'll find something you like!

Ta-da! How is it?
Do I look cool and sharp?

...Nice! It looks great, it really suits you!
Suits definitely look way sharper on adults after all!

........................ Yeah. Yeah.
There's... really no denying this anymore.

Actually... when I drafted the storyboard for that manga, my pen was flying!
I had total confidence it'd turn out great... but looking back—

...Reading it again, it's so blatantly obvious. Even beyond the parts I was aware of,
it's totally packed with memories from the manga exhibition with you, Trainer.
—Well, what did you think!!?

Because the 'experience' I had with you, Trainer,
was so overwhelmingly fun.

Later that night. Kiseki called me out to the beach,
and upon meeting her there—she suddenly handed me a present.

Year 20XX. Early summer. One clear, sunny morning.
The despair began.

No... No, no!!!!
I don't want this, please... No way...!

...That should do it for the barricade!
The ZBSS shouldn't be able to get inside for a while!

Aaaah...! ...*sob*... *sniff*...
............—I'll never forgive them.
